Name: Silent Load Screen (No Music On Save Select - Jukebox - Menu)
Author: DylanJames
Description:
[url=https://ko-fi.com/dylanjamesxyz][center][img]https://github.com/doodlum/nexusmods-widgets/blob/main/Ko-fi_40px_60fps.png?raw=true[/img][/center][/url]

[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS
[/size][/b]
⧉ㅤ[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]

[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Replaces the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QXwX-QD6Y60]load screen music[/url] with silence using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
For when you've been jumpscared at max volume one-too-many times.

The jukebox will also say "Silence" if you have a mod that adds it to the playlist.
You should just blacklist this song in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6017]Better Jukebox[/url] through it's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Mod Config Menu[/url].


[b][size=4]PROBLEM[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
The title menu does not respect any volume settings. They are tied to the save file.
The load screen music sometimes plays [u]even when the global music toggle is off[/u].

You can't target this with Content Patcher because [url=https://github.com/Dannode36/StardewValleyDecompiled/blob/5225ef409e42a6159a82cf81200bf6eb315c9961/Stardew%20Valley/StardewValley.Menus/TitleMenu.cs]the menu hardcoded it[/url] several places.
This mod changes the song and and its name for the jukebox, if it's added by another mod.

I would have liked to keep the original music in the event some mod uses it.
Some DLL bro, please make this mod for me.

Manifest.Name: No Load Screen Music
Manifest.Description: Load Screen is replaced with silence.
